notes.title: Eggcelerate! to the Easter Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43189471/f4156bf427c1390dbfe1f237c34164460126887c.png[/img]

The Easter Bunny made a deal for you to grab [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1535490/Eggcelerate/]Eggcelerate![/url] and Eggcelerate! to the North Pole on Steam this Easter season. Challenge friends on the leaderboards and see if you can improve your own ranks. It is a difficult game!

notes.title: Deliver Eggs in Eggcelerate! to the North Pole, Coming December 15th!
notes.notes:
Eggcelerate! to the North Pole is coming December 15th raising the difficulty brr to a level snowman can do! Hit the slopes to deliver the eggs while drifting around snow banks and balancing the egg.

The temperature has dropped, and so has the friction! Hit the slopes with new jumps and treacherous winter conditions to deliver your carton of eggs! While waiting for release, drop into the original Eggcelerate! and set your best time.

Wishlist the Eggcelerate! to the North Pole now to be among the first delivering eggs!
